Title: Azure Functions support for Node 10 is ending on 30 September 2022

Body.Content:
Because Node 10 reached the end of community support on 30 April 2021, applications hosted on Azure Functions using Node 10 will be unsupported after 30 September 2022. 

Required action 

To avoid any service disruption and potential security vulnerabilities in your applications, we recommend you upgrade to Node 14, and then follow the steps to update your applications settings before 30 September 2022.  

Help and support 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
